description: A retrained model is only a candidate. It replaces the serving champion only when every check below passes; otherwise the champion keeps serving.

retraining_window.rule: All complete labelled service days before the promotion holdout day. Partial days are excluded so every hour of the day is represented equally.

aliases.champion: The version the API should serve.
aliases.previous: The last champion, kept ready for one-step rollback.

approvers: Promotion and rollback record the acting team member; a second team member reviews the lifecycle report before any new image is published (see docs/PHASE3_GOVERNANCE.md).
